item.title: New JConcepts 1993 Ford F250 Mini LMT Body
item.description: JConcepts has now released the popular Ford F-250 for the Losi Mini-LMT Monster Truck platform.

item.title: Drake Talks Tuning With Anti-Squat [VIDEO]
item.description: Mugen Seiki Racing's Adam Drake explains tuning with anti-squat and when and why it should be an option.

item.title: New JConcepts RC10 1989 Stealth Edition Options
item.description: The RC10 1989 Stealth, which was never originally released to the public, is now readily available. JConcepts has jumped on this new vehicle with a list of accessories and option parts including carbon fiber and aluminum hop-up parts.

item.title: New Revolution Design Ultra 6.5" and 7" Wings
item.description: The Revolution Design 1/10 ULTRA Wing series has been developed for the latest generation of 1/10 electric offroad buggies.

item.title: New Team Xray XB4 Multi-Flex Steering System
item.description: The Team Xray XB4 Adjustable Multi-Flex Steering System Brace allows precise adjustment of steering characteristics by changing the mounting position of the servo saver pivot shafts to the chassis.

item.title: New Team Associated RC10B7 67mm HD Univeral Driveshafts
item.description: Introducing the new RC10B7 universal driveshaft set, 67mm! This product is great for those that have the -4mm hubs with the 81mm arms and want to try universal driveshafts in their vehicles.

item.title: Industry Analytics: Weekly Stats [2/11 - 2/18]
item.description: Time for the weekly #IndustryAnalytics check in, over 17,000 entries were entered into the #LiveTimeScoring system for this past week in the RC racing segment. Check out what everyone was racing here.

item.title: New Revolution Design XB2'26 3 Degree Aluminum Bulkhead
item.description: The Revolution Design XB2 26 | 25 Aluminum and Steel Bulkheads +/-3° is a premium tuning option for the Team Xray XB2 platform.

item.title: New JConcepts Pioneer 2.2" Slim 2wd Front Wheel
item.description: The new JConcepts Pioneer slim front wheels for the modern 2wd buggy class have unique features and aesthetics unseen before.

item.title: New Moto-Obscura 10-32 Wheel Nuts
item.description: To complement their 8-32 Aluminum Serrated Wheel Nuts, Moto-Obscura has released a version with 10-32 threads for most vintage Losi vehicles.
